# Guangdong Province Action Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (2025-2027)

Official document. Issued by: General Office of CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee + General Office of Guangdong Provincial Government. Published: 2026-01-30.

## Key Provisions (relevant to data centers)
- **Section: 海洋信息产业 (Marine Information Industry)**: "加快布局海洋电子信息产业。促进数字经济与海洋产业融合发展。积极参与全国海洋观测网建设，依托深圳智慧海洋技术储备，探索发展海洋电子信息'感、传、存、算、用'产业，**探索在有条件的地市谋划建设海底数据中心**。"
  - Translation: "Accelerate the layout of the marine electronic information industry. Promote the integrated development of the digital economy and marine industries. Actively participate in the construction of the national marine observation network. Relying on Shenzhen's smart ocean technology reserves, explore the development of the marine electronic information 'sensing, transmission, storage, calculation, application' industry. **Explore planning and building underwater data centers in prefecture-level cities with the necessary conditions.**"

## Structure
- 14 major action areas covering: marine technology, fisheries, oil & gas, shipbuilding, engineering equipment, chemicals, marine pharmaceuticals, new energy (offshore wind, solar), seawater utilization, transportation, tourism, information industry, and more.
- The underwater data center provision is a single clause within the marine information industry section.
